messages:
mike_support: Ping — Janet from Acme reporting a sudden spike of 502/504s on hosted inference starting ~2024-10-12T06:10Z. Customer is seeing fail-fast errors and lots of SDK retries. Ccing @linda_engineer and @sebastian_sre.

janet_acme: repro steps: single generate request -> immediate 502. Region switch to us-west-2 returned success for a handful, then failures resumed. Sample curl below: 
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-3b","input":"hello"}'
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway

mike_support: Customer reports >20% of requests failing for 10+ minutes, SDK retry loop impacting downstream service (billing concern). They need ETA and mitigation.

linda_engineer: Looking. Can you paste one full request/response trace (no secrets) and the SDK client logs around retries? Also confirm content-length sizes — large prompts can hit edge timeouts.

janet_acme: Attached logs (sanitized) — most failures show: 
```
[2024-10-12T06:12:03Z] INFO -> POST /v1/generate 502 18ms x-retry:1
[2024-10-12T06:12:05Z] WARN -> POST /v1/generate 504 15ms x-retry:2
[2024-10-12T06:12:10Z] ERROR -> POST /v1/generate network error: stream reset
```
Payload size ~ 150KB per request.

sebastian_sre: (initial hypothesis) edge proxy returning 502/504 under connection/keepalive churn. Deploy-bot, any deploys or config changes around 06:00–06:15Z?

deploy-bot: No deploys during 05:45Z–06:30Z. Autoscaling events: increased pool size at 06:08Z for pool:hosted-gen-usw2, health checks returned to GREEN at 06:09Z.

linda_engineer: Trying to reproduce from our side with similar payloads. Small suggestion for customer: temporarily increase client timeout and set retry-backoff to jittered exponential to avoid retry storm. Example SDK snippet: 
```js
client.request({timeout: 30_000, retries: 3, backoff: {base:100, max:2000, jitter:true}})
```

mike_support: Shared that workaround; customer applied and saw reduced retry loops but still ~10% 5xx. They asked if we can route them to a stable capacity partition or give a short SLA window.

sebastian_sre: Checking edge and gateway logs for correlation. Querying: "status=502 OR status=504" and client_ip=j* and model=redwood-alpha-3b between 2024-10-12T06:05 and 06:20.

sys-bot: Query result: 412 matching requests. Top error path: tcp reset between edge-proxy-03 and txn-gw-4. Latency distribution skewed at p95 1200ms.

linda_engineer: Found pattern: requests with content-length > 100KB hit gateway windowing codepath that sometimes races with keepalive pruning. Patching a guard in staging now to avoid double-close during backpressure. Will test and lean to hotfix if validated.

mike_support: ETA for hotfix? Customer asking for timeline so they can plan rollback.

linda_engineer: Quick test in staging shows fix reduces 502/504 to <1% for large payloads. I'll request an expedited rollout to canary region in 15m, full rollout 1h after canary if metrics look good.

janet_acme: Appreciate the quick work. For now we've throttled request size to 80KB and increased retry backoffs. We'll standby for canary results.

sebastian_sre: Temporary mitigation on infra side: increased gateway keepalive window and bumped ingress buffer to tolerate larger bodies for affected tenants. That should reduce the immediate spike while patch rolls out.

mike_support: Communicated interim mitigation and expected timeline to customer: canary 15m, wider rollout ~1h. Customer acknowledged and will monitor.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at 2024-10-12T06:40Z to eu-west-1. Health checks: pass. Monitoring p95 5xx decreased from 12% -> 0.8% in canary.

linda_engineer: Canary looks good. Rolling to remaining regions. Will post final notes and the changelist once fully rolled.

mike_support: Thanks all — I'll update Janet with final resolution once global rollout finishes. Marking as high priority until 06:50Z when roll completes. :thumbsup:
